Not investment advice. Two methods each make a call on each stock the day's screen picked, from the same public facts: Jev answers questions and fixed rules turn the answers into a call; Opus makes its own. This is an experiment, and both are scored against prices later. Every figure in a reason was written by code from the facts sheet.
